originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
layout [direction: DOWN]
ContentSource database as "Content Store"
Crawler service as "Crawler Service"
ParserService service as "Parser Service"
Tokenizer service as "Tokenizer"
IndexBuilder service as "Index Builder"
SearchIndex database as "Search Index"
User service as "User"
QueryService service as "Query Service"
RankingService service as "Ranking Service"

edge_1 = Crawler -> ContentSource as "fetch documents"
edge_2 = Crawler -> ParserService as "send raw content"
edge_3 = ParserService -> Tokenizer as "extract text"
edge_4 = Tokenizer -> IndexBuilder as "emit tokens"
edge_5 = IndexBuilder -> SearchIndex as "write index"
edge_6 = User -> QueryService as "submits search query"
edge_7 = QueryService -> SearchIndex as "lookup terms"
edge_8 = SearchIndex -> RankingService as "return matches"
edge_9 = RankingService -> QueryService as "return ranked results"
edge_10 = QueryService -> User as "display results"

injectedDefects.description: replaced closing quote on label "Content Store" with Unicode look-alike U+201D
